periods.time: Final day of the Seven Stars Festival
periods.label: 观测未来的总理

status.current: observes the final and hears Edelweiss confirm Ikki's value against a despair-filled future
status.condition: still pursuing political aims after Akatsuki's tournament defeat

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Young Akatsuki contractor he reassures after their losses.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Akatsuki member present under Color Magic concealment.
relationships.edelweiss: World-class contact who asks him for a seat and explains the meaning of Ikki's awakening.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Young knight whose childhood effort Tsukikage once witnessed and whose future importance he now sees.

periods.summary: Tsukikage is revealed to have helped secure the final's postponement. Before the match he meets Rinna, Charlotte and Sara, forgives Akatsuki's failure, and says politics requires finding other means. Edelweiss warns him of foreign agents and reminds him of the future calamity he has seen. After Ikki's impossible awakening, Tsukikage accepts Edelweiss's claim that Ikki and Stella might become hope against that future, recalling the lonely boy he once saw practicing at the Kurogane estate.

key_events.summary: Is mentioned as having aided the special decision to delay the final.
Meets Edelweiss and is warned about foreign agents and future threats.
Hears that Ikki's awakening may create a new, more hopeful future.

periods.time: Night after the Seven Stars award ceremony
periods.label: 揭露魔人与未来灾厄
periods.affiliation: Japanese government; International Mage-Knight League member state leadership

status.current: abandons his failed anti-League plan and entrusts Japan's future to the younger generation
status.condition: emotionally exhausted after a decade of trying to avoid a foretold disaster

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Informs him of the Desperado realm and asks him to keep it secret.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Shows her the future destruction of Tokyo and explains why the League hides Desperado knowledge.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Former student/associate who witnesses his confession.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Named as one of Japan's known Desperado and witnesses the explanation.

periods.summary: Tsukikage summons Ikki, Stella, Kurono, and Nene to the empty Bay Dome. After Ascaride tests Ikki and Stella, Tsukikage explains that Ikki has become a Desperado: someone who has stepped outside the planet's fate and can grow beyond fixed magical limits. He then reveals Moon Heaven Jewel, a national secret Device that can view the past and sometimes show future memories, displaying a future in which Tokyo is devastated by war. He explains that the impending death of Rebellion's Tyrant may collapse the three-power balance and cause World War III, which drove his attempt to move Japan away from the League. Seeing Ikki and Stella break fate convinces him to entrust the future to them instead.

key_events.summary: Arranges the meeting where Ikki learns about Desperado.
Confesses the future vision behind his political actions.

periods.label: 以月天宝珠读取惨剧的日本首相

status.current: attempting to notify the League when communications fail and SCION approaches
status.condition: unharmed but alarmed by worsening future risks

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Ally who supported his Seven Stars reform attempt and asks him to read the past.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: His previous reliance on Rebellion indirectly led Or-Gaule to Stella and Ikki's circle.

periods.summary: Tsukikage accompanies the Kazamatsuri group to the devastated Rebellion headquarters, apologizes to Kozo for failing to achieve Japan's break from the League, and agrees to inspect the past with Moon Heaven Jewel. He witnesses Or-Gaule's massacre, Wallenshtein's death, the formation of Or-Gaule's breakaway faction, and their plan to destroy Vermillion and Quedland. He recognizes the crisis as partly tied to his earlier use of underworld power and decides to inform the International Mage-Knight League immediately. Before he can reach them, communications fail and SCION's Abraham Carter approaches the base, suggesting the world is moving toward the future Tsukikage feared.

key_events.summary: Uses Moon Heaven Jewel to reconstruct the massacre and identify Or-Gaule's plan.
